Interview: Guerrilla Fighter Shahzaman
2014-11-23T00:01:57+06:00 | Zaid Kalam
https://www.thedailystar.net/guerrilla-fighter-shahzaman-part-1-54481

Shahzaman Mozumder Bir Protik goes back to the heroic days of our 1971 Liberation War and tells the story of the battle of Ashuganj and the Muktibahini's march towards Dhaka . Watch more: Guerrilla Fighter Shahzaman (Part 2)

This interview in two parts was first published on our Freedom in the Air repository in November 23, 2014 .
